### 🎨 Theme Name
e.g. Tokyo Night, Nord, Gruvbox, Dracula, Solarized

### 🔗 Official Source / Specification
Link to the theme's official repository or color palette specifications.

### 🖼️ Preview Reference

### 💡 Why should this be in More Gravity Theme?
Briefly explain why this theme fits the Antigravity developer ecosystem.
